reference_photos.reuse_note: Confirm image identity, license, attribution, source page, and reuse terms before use.

specimen_appearance_pair.comparison_rule: Assign two looks only after visual source review. Describe age, molt/exuvia state, wear, or freshness only when evidence supports it.

pose_plan.consistency_rule: Keep each look identity stable across its six views; keep the two looks distinct from each other.

required_next_steps: Inspect reference images and reject wrong taxa or unsuitable views.
Record visible proportions, color, hair density, texture, and specimen condition with source links.
Fill the LOOK-A and LOOK-B evidence fields from visually reviewed references; never infer age or exuvia condition from name metadata.
Generate six views for each accepted look, preserving each look consistently across its views, then review and refine each result.
